chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) regarding the description of one who volunteers for judgment among the people while not being fit for it.
And in it: The most hated of creatures to Allah are two types.
ai.seo_question: Who are the most hated creatures to Allah according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this sermon from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) critiques the phenomenon of unqualified individuals assuming judicial authority, a theme central to Shia political theology regarding the necessity of 'Adl (justice) and 'Ilm (knowledge) in leadership. He identifies these unfit rulers as among the most hated of creatures to Allah, emphasizing that illegitimate governance corrupts the social order. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the moral and intellectual fitness of the judge, linking it directly to divine pleasure and displeasure.

en.sayed-ali-raza: About those who sit for dispensation of justice among people but are not fit for it.
